freshness.basis: provisional: two 5-minute publication intervals plus one source bucket

conditions.label: Calm
conditions.sentence: Conditions are within the normal range for this time of day.
conditions.headline: Calm
conditions.universal_not_observed: user intent, emotional state, correctness, coordination, culpability, or geographic origin
conditions.plain: Everything measured is within its usual range for this hour of day.
conditions.criteria: Every measured quantity is within its usual range for this hour of day.

reasons.plain: Interaction activity is 1.0x its typical level for this hour of day — within the usual range for this hour.
Variability is within its usual range for this hour.

conditions.confidence_plain: Compared against 24 previous days of this same hour. The window now in progress is not yet complete.

pairings.observed: Interaction activity is 1.0x its typical level for this hour of day — within the usual range for this hour.
pairings.not_observed: That anyone is upset, or that the activity is hostile. A like and a furious quote-post are one event each here.

pairings.observed: Variability is within its usual range for this hour.
pairings.not_observed: That a community is unstable. This is a property of an observed rate series at one endpoint.

cannot_see: How many people are involved, or how many are new. The counters aggregate events, not accounts, so participant turnover is unavailable by construction rather than unimplemented.
What is being said. Record bodies are discarded before storage.
Where anyone is. The protocol exposes no location and none is inferred.
Who did anything. No actor or target is retained at any point.
criteria_table: The instrument produced no reading, or its most recent complete reading is more than 15 windows old.
The window was not observed, or the baseline for this hour is too thin to compare against.
Interaction activity is above the 95th percentile for this hour of day, at least 3x its typical level, and has stayed elevated for 3 or more windows.
Interaction activity is above the 95th percentile for this hour of day and has stayed elevated for 2 or more windows.
Activity or its variability is elevated for this hour of day and has persisted across 2 or more windows.
Activity or its variability is elevated for this hour of day, but has not persisted.
Interaction activity is above the 75th percentile for this hour of day.
Every measured quantity is within its usual range for this hour of day.

claim: Aggregate activity observed from this Jetstream source during the stated observation interval.
measures: rates of aggregate ATProto events (posts, likes, follows, blocks, deletes, account/identity events) and the health of the observation itself

history.note: `windows` holds only the most recent windows. Older windows are published one UTC day per file under `history/`; fetch `history/index.json` to see which days exist. The archive carries the same fields at the same precision as `windows` and adds nothing.

notes: Unobserved windows are omitted from every rate; nothing is interpolated across them.
Rates divide by observed duration, not nominal window width.
No relay is treated as complete or authoritative.

Rates are as observed at this endpoint and are not estimates of total-network activity. A controlled probe (2026-08-08) compared two same-region public Jetstream endpoints over one interval and found post volumes differing by ~1.61x (same-endpoint self-control 1.000): relays are not interchangeable.
That ratio is an inter-observer comparison, not a coverage or completeness figure: there is no canonical denominator.
